ModMetaData.name: Storyteller Telemetry
ModMetaData.author: Cookis
ModMetaData.description:
Records what the storyteller does and how the colony copes, as JSON Lines files, for training an adaptive difficulty model.
Logged: every incident (with resolved raid points, faction, strategy, arrival mode and raid composition), periodic colony snapshots (wealth, threat points and their factors, colonists, defenses, resources, hostiles), pawn downed/death/kidnap events, mental breaks, and per-fight "engagement" summaries.
Changes nothing about gameplay. Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
Output: [RimWorld save data folder]/StorytellerTelemetry/
